convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iRSI, iBands). Simple crossover entry/exit rules. Fixed lot position sizing. No external .mqh libraries. No grid, martingale, or hedging logic.

other_exits: Close long when RSI crosses above Upper Band (overbought reversal)
Close short when RSI crosses below Lower Band (oversold reversal)

custom_logic_notes: RSI is used as the price-series input to Bollinger Bands in some variants, but the standard interpretation for this EA is: RSI indicator values compared against Bollinger Band levels applied to price. Long entry when RSI is below lower band (oversold with BB expansion). Short entry when RSI is above upper band (overbought with BB expansion). SL at middle band, TP at opposite band. The EA closes opposing positions before opening new ones (signal_reversal_close=true).
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Use ta-lib or pandas-ta for RSI and Bollinger Bands. Entry signals use previous completed bar (shift=1). SL/TP are indicator-based (middle band and opposite band), so calculate these values at entry time and set as price levels. New bar detection needed to prevent repeated signals within the same bar. Position check before entry to avoid stacking trades.
